**Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge** is a psychiatric outpatient facility for children and youth located in Hillerød, Denmark. As a specialized unit within the Danish healthcare system, it reports its diagnostic and treatment data to the national [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] [^src2]. The facility is notable for its consistently high performance in specific areas of ADHD assessment, standing out against a broader systemic backdrop where many national process indicators fall significantly below the 90% standard.

The facility's most significant achievement is its quality in ADHD assessments, measured by [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]]. Hillerød achieved the highest fulfillment rate among all larger facilities, reaching 81% (95% CI: 77–84) for the period of April 1, 2023, to March 31, 2024 [^src1]. This recent success is part of a sustained trend of high-quality assessments, with the facility previously recording fulfillment rates of 80% in 2022/23 and 86% in 2021/22 [^src1]. 

Performance across other quality metrics presents a more mixed picture, reflecting broader systemic challenges in resource allocation and clinical practices. For [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]], which measures pharmacological treatment, the facility recorded a medication rate of 69% [^src2]. However, for Indikator 2a—which tracks the proportion of ADHD assessments for children aged 0–5 that include a clinical environmental observation within 120 days—the facility achieved a 25% fulfillment rate (11 out of 44 cases) in 2023/24 [^src3]. This variance highlights the ongoing difficulties child and adolescent psychiatry departments face in meeting stringent diagnostic standards for younger age groups.

## Claims

### Performance
- Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge har en opfyldelse på 81 % (95 % CI: 77–84) for Indikator 1 i perioden 01.04.2023–31.03.2024 [^src1] (hillerod-psykiatrisk-ambulatorium-boern-og-unge, indikator-1) [^src1]
- Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge, Hillerød, B39 har en medicinrate på 69 % [^src1] (hillerod-psykiatrisk-ambulatorium-boern-og-unge, indikator-6) [^src2]

### Statistical
